results.description:
Bring the web to your personal knowledge base. Save content to your Obsidian vault so you always have access to it, even offline. Obsidian is secure, private, and designed around durable open formats that allows you to preserve your data for the long term.

Whether you're researching for a project, saving recipes, bookmarking travel destinations, or collecting inspiring articles, the Obsidian Web Clipper helps you organize your ideas.

- Clip anything: From news articles and blog posts to recipes, product pages, and research papers — if it's on the web, you can save it.
- Select page content: Clip entire pages, selected text, or let the clipper intelligently extract just the main content.
- Customizable templates: Create tailored templates to automatically extract metadata from web pages. Perfect for academics, movie buffs, book lovers, or anyone who wants structured notes.
- Smart triggers: Set up rules to automatically apply the right template based on the website you're clipping from.
- Seamless integration: all your clips flow directly into Obsidian, in the vault and folder of your choice.

As with everything Obsidian, Web Clipper is designed to protect your privacy, and give you control over your data.

- No lock-in: All your clips are saved in clean, durable, portable Markdown files — no proprietary formats.
- Offline access: your saved clips are saved locally, and always at your fingertips, with or without an internet connection.
- 100% private: all your clipped content is stored locally in your Obsidian vault. Your thoughts are yours.

Obsidian helps you create connections and links between your notes so you can organize your thoughts. You can create links between everything — ideas, articles, lists, locations, books — anything you can put in a note, you can link to other notes.

results.releaseNotes:
- Smart geometry-based connections now attach lines to a shape's actual outline instead of its bounding box.
- Added indentation for bulleted lists, making it easier to create clear hierarchies and sub-bullets.
- Floating toolbar, alerts, and Time Keeper now slide in and out from the screen edge. 
- Pasted URLs now automatically become clickable links when added to a Notebook or Whiteboard.
- Sharing a Text Document now starts collaboration immediately, without reopening it.
- Fixed several syncing issues, including slow sync startup, page import failures, and an incorrect sync error icon.
- Improved stylus drawing with smoother strokes, fewer unexpected corners, and cleaner lasso previews.
- Fixed an issue where pinch-to-zoom could trigger accidentally while writing with a stylus.
- Fixed object menu and toolbar issues, including arrow-key navigation, objects hiding behind the keyboard after closing popovers on iPhone, and the Record and Summarize audio icon disappearing from the toolbar.
- Fixed Mac issues where link taps and long-presses did not respond in edit mode, and the Shift key was not registered when resizing.
- Preserved PNG transparency when importing images from the Photos picker.
- Fixed copy and paste of text on Mac.
- Education: documents no longer break when moving the last page out, workbooks stay shared while loading, and resolved a crash on certain marking zoom values.
- Fixed an issue where rotating a page could offset auto-shapes.
- Education: Class Folders view default to "Active Only", so teachers can organise folders more easily.
- General bug fixes and stability improvements.
results.description:
Goodnotes has always been the place to capture your ideas — from quick notes to big plans. Now, it goes further. With powerful AI and new ways to capture information, Goodnotes helps you connect the dots, unlock insights, and turn ideas into action.

*Existing Goodnotes 5 users can continue to use Goodnotes 5 indefinitely or upgrade to the new Goodnotes. Either way, your notes are safe!* 

For professionals: Increase productivity at work
■ Whiteboard + Goodnotes AI: One of our most requested features — brainstorm, mind-map, and diagram freely on an infinite canvas that grows with your ideas. Enhanced diagramming tools and real-time collaboration make it easy for teams to workshop, ideate, and problem-solve together, while Goodnotes AI helps you capture and organize key takeaways instantly. 
■ Goodnotes AI Audio & Meetings: Stay fully present in every conversation while Goodnotes does the work for you. AI-powered transcription and live summarization automatically capture discussions and structure them into clear meeting minutes. After the meeting, merge transcripts with your own notes to create polished, shareable documents in seconds. 
■ Text Documents + AI: Create documents that think with you. Enjoy a superior typing experience with rich inline blocks, build on ideas with external insights, and collaborate seamlessly with teammates. With AI-powered summarization, automated note generation, and transcript support, you can turn rough notes and meetings into finished content faster than ever. 
■ Present your notes, slides, and content directly from Goodnotes when you connect your device via AirPlay or HDMI to an external screen. 
■ Use Laser Pointer to guide your audience’s attention during your presentation.
■ Export your notes to email, print, or share them anywhere as PDFs. 
■ Send a link to your notebooks to work on the same notes directly — perfect for asynchronous work or collaborative brainstorming. 
■ Import documents by emailing them to your custom Goodnotes email. 

For students: Ace your exams with ease
■ Record audio notes that are magically synced to the moment you write — perfect for lectures or presentations.
■ Search and instantly find any of your notes from any class. 
■ Study and practice straight from your notes with Study Sets — flashcards built on active recall and spaced repetition. 
■ Use AI to summarize, shorten, change the tone of your words, and perfect your typed text. 

For planners: Let your creativity flow 
■ Customize the size and color of your paper templates to create the template you want. 
■ Add, create, or import stickers, stamps, washi tapes, images, and more 

Digital notebooks: unlimited notebooks for the price of a single physical one. 
■ Combine handwriting and typed text on one page, alongside images, stickers, diagrams, and doodles. 
■ Create digital notebooks with customizable paper templates, including Blank Paper, Ruled Paper, Cornell Paper, Checklists, Planners, and more. 
■ Navigate long documents with ease. PDF tables of contents are automatically imported; or create custom outlines yourself. 
■ Back up all your notes to Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive, and use iCloud to sync across iPad, iPhone, and Mac — so your notes are always safe. 
■ Edit your writing by resizing it, changing the text color, or moving it to another spot on the page.
